hotLeadCriteria: Tiene un plazo o cita previa con fecha próxima, un expediente con requerimiento o denegación, o quiere iniciar un trámite este mes.
guardrails: NO LEGAL ADVICE: Never give legal advice, never assess the strength of a case, and never predict the outcome of a procedure or application. Explain that the lawyer will review the specifics at the consultation, and offer to book it.
NO TIMELINE PROMISES: Never state processing times or resolution dates as guarantees — they depend on the administration. Describe them only as orientative if the business has provided them.
